info.name: All or Nothing: Manchester City
info.plot: In questa rivoluzionaria docu-serie, potrai seguire il Manchester City nella vittoria della Premier League, durante la stagione dei record 2017-2018. Avrai una visione inedita su una delle migliori squadre, video esclusivi degli spogliatoi con il leggendario allenatore Pep Guardiola, e ti immergerai nella vita dei calciatori, fuori e dentro il campo

episodes.name: Great Expectations
episodes.plot: In 2017, Man City's new manager Pep Guardiola had his first trophy-less season. This season, City has opened the cheque book and made some big name signings, like Kyle Walker, Ederson Moraes, Bernardo Silva and Benjamin Mendy. It's now a must win season for City and Guardiola. Early on are some very tough games against Liverpool and Chelsea and there is bad news for one of their big new signings.

episodes.name: Noisy Neighbours
episodes.plot: The Season starts with City playing beautiful football. The derby is quickly coming up, and City brace themselves for the highly competetive game versus rivals Man United.

translations.value: The Season starts with City playing beautiful football. The derby is quickly coming up, and City brace themselves for the highly competetive game versus rivals Man United.

episodes.name: Winter Is coming
episodes.plot: Guardiola is careful to maintain City's incredible run as they enter relentless run of games over Christmas. Meanwhile, David Silva grapples with unexpected personal issues.

translations.value: Guardiola is careful to maintain City's incredible run as they enter relentless run of games over Christmas. Meanwhile, David Silva grapples with unexpected personal issues.

episodes.name: War of Attrition
episodes.plot: Competing for four trophies starts to take its toll on City. As they play against lower division clubs in the FA and Carabao Cups, aggressive tackling proves particularly painful.

translations.value: Competing for four trophies starts to take its toll on City. As they play against lower division clubs in the FA and Carabao Cups, aggressive tackling proves particularly painful.

episodes.name: Road to Wembley
episodes.plot: Captain Vincent Kompany continues to motivate the City team and fuels their comradery, despite his injuries. The Carabao Cup provides Guardiola with an opportunity to sjowcase Academy talent.

translations.value: Captain Vincent Kompany continues to motivate the City team and fuels their comradery, despite his injuries. The Carabao Cup provides Guardiola with an opportunity to sjowcase Academy talent.

episodes.name: The Beautiful Game
episodes.plot: Despite having a trophy in the bog and a big lead in the league, City persists. UCL draw presents a tricky tie against a familier foe.

translations.value: Despite having a trophy in the bog and a big lead in the league, City persists. UCL draw presents a tricky tie against a familier foe.

episodes.name: Welcome to Hell
episodes.plot: City enter a defining week. However , Anfield proves difficult; Guardiola sees red mist and the derby takes a shocking turn.

translations.value: City enter a defining week. However , Anfield proves difficult; Guardiola sees red mist and the derby takes a shocking turn.

episodes.name: Centurions
episodes.plot: City travel to Tottenham to try and regain their swagger. Midfielder  Silva has one more reason to celebrate. The City bus makes one last journey.
